summary: Stark Focus Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a change in control via a stock purchase agreement dated June 9, 2026, with closing on June 25. Purchaser MJG Polo LLC acquired 8,300,000 shares (83.43% of outstanding common stock) from selling stockholder Compass North Holdings Limited for $355,000 total ($0.0428 per share). No premium, board recommendation, or advisor named. The Purchase Agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnities. What to watch: regulatory scrutiny of a controlling stake transfer and potential subsequent going-private or squeeze-out transaction; risk-arb focuses on minority shareholder treatment and liquidity.
